Omantel - New Baqati: The new plans are available for both new and existing customers, including those switching from prepaid to postpaid or upgrading from their current plans. Once a customer activates a new Baqati plan, they cannot revert to old plans. All new Baqati plans are of 12 months Contract (except Baqati 11) if terminated would incurred an early exit fee calculated as per following formula: 2 x monthly recurring charge of your Baqati plan x (remaining number of months of contract / 12). All plans would have default PAYG Data Blocker for Local as well as while roaming. For the Data rollover only the unused main data from the plan bundle can be carried forward to the next month. Smart SIMs can be used seamlessly across different smart devices (e.g., Camera’s, Home gates, Smart home devices, etc.) available to all Baqati plans at a monthly fee of OMR 1. Once the Smart SIM data allowance is fully consumed, customers may subscribe to any of the available local data add-ons.

Omantel - New Baqati: All Baqati customers will receive a clear monthly bill detailing national and international calls, data usage, roaming charges, and monthly subscription fees. Data Rollover for Baqati 11: Activate via the Omantel App for OMR 2/month. It auto-renews monthly until cancelled in the app. Payment is due 30 days from the bill date. Bills can be viewed and paid conveniently via the Omantel App. Roaming & International The new Baqati plans do not include PAYG roaming data, ensuring that customers are protected from any unexpected charges. Customers may select from the available Jawazak roaming bundles whenever they require data usage while traveling outside Oman. To check the list of Baqati Roaming Destination countries
